successors.name: County of Toulouse
successors.text: the Rouergue outline of 1065, taken by William IV and Raymond of Saint-Gilles of Toulouse; Cliopatria adds it to Toulouse in 1066

ledger.x: Page silent on the county's origin: 990 is Cliopatria's first year for the row.

1053: Hugh of Rouergue dies and the county passes to his heiress Bertha, whom William IV of Toulouse and Raymond of Saint-Gilles contest: 'On Hugh of Rouergue's death in 1053, his heiress Bertha contested the Rouergue with William IV of Toulouse and Raymond of Saint-Gilles.'
1065: Bertha dies and the Rouergue passes to the counts of Toulouse.

wars.name: Dispute over the Rouergue inheritance
wars.outcome: Bertha, Hugh of Rouergue's heiress, contested the county with William IV of Toulouse and his brother Raymond of Saint-Gilles from 1053; after her death in 1065 the brothers fought each other and an agreement (undated) recognised Raymond in the Rouergue.

certainty.note: A feudal county drawn from Cliopatria's outline; no page gives a boundary, and the outline is three times the area of Rouergue proper.
